title: Firefly species formally assessed vs. still unstudied

source.name: Evaluating firefly extinction risk: initial Red List assessments for North America
source.publisher: Xerces Society / IUCN Firefly Specialist Group, PLOS ONE (2021)

notes: 132 of the roughly 172 described firefly species in the US and Canada (about 77%) had enough data to be formally assessed for extinction risk as of the 2021 study; the rest remain data-deficient.
